Subject: Request to preserve demo window — PO in procurement

Hi Sofia,

Quick note — we're live-testing Redwood in our staging environment this week ahead of a product review next Thursday. Our procurement team ran into an extra compliance check and the PO is stuck in review (I expect it to clear, but not before the trial window closes).

Would Redwood be able to hold the demo timer or grant a short set of credits so we can keep the environment live for the review? We don't want to lose momentum with our engineering stakeholders.

We're planning to submit a PO today and I can follow up with the PO number to finalize billing. Appreciate any temporary help you can provide.

Thanks,
Angela Park
Product Operations Manager
CedarCloud Health

Attachments: CedarCloud_Requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Hi Angela — thanks for the heads-up and congrats on getting the review scheduled.

We can definitely help keep the sandbox live. I can propose a short, conditional credit grant to preserve your demo window while procurement finishes the PO. Two options we typically use:

- 72-hour sandbox buffer (no charge) to keep the environment active
- Conditional fractional credit (25k token voucher) that is applied immediately and reconciled once we receive the PO

Can you confirm an expected PO ETA (approx date) and whether procurement will provide a PO number or an invoice contact? If you want me to escalate for a slightly larger buffer I can loop in my manager and finance.

If it's helpful I can also prepare a brief one-page terms stub for the credits (expiration and conversion terms).

Happy to proceed as soon as you confirm which option you prefer.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Sofia — thanks for flagging.

Approved to provide a temporary credit to keep CedarCloud's demo live. Given this is a mid-market new-commercial opportunity, let's do a 3-day (72hr) sandbox buffer plus a 25k token voucher applied today. Conditions:

- Voucher expires 30 days after issue if we do not receive a PO
- Procurement should provide PO number or signed SOW within 5 business days; otherwise credits revert
- Finance (cc'd) will record the voucher as an advance and reconcile on PO receipt

Marissa — can you confirm the accounting code and attach the credit terms (short stub) so Sofia can send it to the customer?

Sofia — proceed and apply the voucher now; note the voucher code in HubSpot and attach the terms.
